title: Icarus Digital Marketing: Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer
description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. The work You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. • Decide what each batch should test and why. • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. What you must be good at • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish • Fast, organised batch production • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test You are probably not right for this role if • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context. • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism. • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work. • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision. • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production. • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples. • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback. What success looks like Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow. Compensation The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000 . If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month , based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator. We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output. How to apply Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work. • Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed. • For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel. • Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable. • Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed. • List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset. • Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test. • State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial. Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/icarus-digital-marketing-performance-creative-strategist-and-ai-producer

title: Internship Go-to-Market Engineering, AI & Automation (m/f/d)
description:
Dein Impact

autarc is building the operating system for energy installers across Europe. As we scale, we want our Go-to-Market organization to operate with the same level of automation, data quality, and product thinking as our engineering organization.


In this Internship, you will work on the technical infrastructure behind our revenue engine.


You will work directly with our Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, and Product teams to identify bottlenecks, build internal tools, automate workflows, connect systems, and deploy AI where it creates measurable commercial impact.


Role description

What You’ll Do

Work on our GTM operating system

  • Build the systems powering our entire customer lifecycle – from first lead to closed customer and expansion.

  • Build internal applications and workflows that help SDRs, Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, and leadership make better decisions and execute faster.

  • Turn fragmented processes into scalable systems.


Automate the revenue engine

  • Identify repetitive or inefficient workflows across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success and automate them.

  • Build automations for areas such as lead enrichment, routing, qualification, follow-ups, pipeline management, customer onboarding, and retention.

  • Connect our GTM stack and ensure information moves reliably between systems.


Integrate AI into real workflows

  • Move AI beyond prototypes.

  • Build AI-powered workflows that help us qualify and prioritize leads, analyze calls and customer interactions, identify opportunities and risks, generate insights, and automate operational work.

  • Experiment rapidly with new models and tools and turn successful experiments into reliable internal products.


Build, don’t just recommend

  • You will personally implement what you design.

  • Depending on the problem, that might mean writing Python or TypeScript, building an n8n workflow, connecting an API, querying a database, prototyping an internal application, or working with our engineers on a deeper integration.

  • You should be comfortable moving between commercial conversations and technical implementation.


Drive measurable commercial impact

  • Technology is a means, not the outcome.

  • Your work should ultimately help us generate more pipeline, increase conversion, shorten sales cycles, improve retention, or allow our GTM organization to scale without adding unnecessary complexity.

  • You will work closely with GTM leadership to identify the highest-leverage problems and own them from idea to measurable result.


Requirements

  • You are a builder. When you see a broken process, your instinct is to understand it and build something better.

  • You have strong technical skills and have worked in Python and/or TypeScript

  • You have hands-on experience building automations and integrations using tools such as n8n and APIs

  • You are comfortable working with databases, APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines

  • You are interested in Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and the systems behind how SAAS companies create revenue 

  • You can translate an ambiguous business problem into a technical solution without needing a detailed specification

  • You move fast, iterate, and are comfortable shipping a first version before everything is perfect

  • You are fluent in English. German or another European language is a plus

title: Training Operations Coordinator (m/f/d)
description:
As a Training Operations Coordinator, you ensure that Quantum Systems' trainings and demo missions run smoothly. You coordinate training activities, manage UAV assets and equipment, maintain system readiness, and continuously improve the operational processes that enable our global training organization to scale. Working alongside our world-class team, you will not only support daily operations but actively shape how we scale and optimize our training setup.

You will collaborate closely with stakeholders from Repair, Support, Production, Fulfilment, Software Engineering, and Marketing to deliver world-class trainings and outstanding demos. Beyond coordination, you will drive operational excellence by defining standards, improving processes, and managing internal initiatives to support Quantum Systems in becoming the benchmark for aerial data collection solutions with unmanned aerial systems (sUAV).


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Training & Demo Operations - Coordinate and support UAV training courses and demo events from planning through execution. Organize schedules, participants, logistics, training materials, and operational readiness. Act as the central point of contact for internal stakeholders and training participants. Ensure smooth preparation and execution of all training and demonstration activities.

  • UAV Fleet & Equipment Readiness - Manage the allocation, handover, return, and tracking of UAV systems, payloads, batteries, and accessories. Maintain training and demo systems in an operationally ready condition. Perform software and firmware updates and coordinate repairs, maintenance, and replacement equipment when required. Maintain inventory records and ensure equipment availability for upcoming activities.

  • Process Improvement & Team Operations - Continuously improve training and demo processes, standards, and documentation. Support the implementation of workflows, automations, and digital tools to increase efficiency. Coordinate internal improvement initiatives and contribute to scaling the global training organization. Support creation and maintenance of operational procedures, training documentation, and reporting structures.

  • Administrative & Compliance Support - Maintain training records, certifications, flight logs, and operational documentation. Support audits and ensure compliance with aviation and internal quality requirements.Assist with reporting, onboarding activities, and day-to-day administrative tasks.




What you bring to the team:

  • You have completed vocational training in a commercial, administrative, or operational field (e.g. office management, administration) or have equivalent practical experience.

  • You bring at least 1–3 years of experience in operations, project coordination, training management, or a comparable role.

  • You have a strong interest in process optimization, operational excellence, and improving how things work.

  • You are structured, solution-oriented, and take ownership of topics, driving them forward independently.

  • You enjoy combining operational coordination with hands-on work involving UAV systems and equipment.

  • You know JIRA/Confluence or similar tools.

  • Your open, communicative, and confident manner allows you to quickly establish yourself as a trusted internal point of contact.

  • Fluent communication in German and English is a matter of course for you.

  • This position requires a predominant activity on site in Gilching, as the support of our training and demo systems as well as the equipment can only be carried out directly at the site.


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile working: If it gets too turbulent for you in our office, you can get the necessary balance through mobile working.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Pasing in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.


Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

title: Graduate Internship, Operations Team
description:
About Ember

We're building the future of public transport — convenient, connected, affordable and zero-emission. Our goal is to make it easier to get from A to B with Ember than it is with your own car.

We’ve already demonstrated that it's possible to use electric buses more intensively than anyone else in the world. This leads to a massive emissions reduction and is only possible because we control the full-stack and integrate it tightly together. That includes the tech platform, the charging infrastructure and the vehicles themselves. This also means we’re providing a much better passenger experience with innovative features like demand-responsive stops.


We’ve come a long way and there’s much more to come, with the arrival of new vehicles, launch of new routes and hubs to continue to grow our network, it’s a very exciting time for Ember. The challenge is to scale 100x whilst staying lean, increasing efficiency and delivering an even better product experience. We’ve already successfully raised equity from some of Europe’s leading climate VCs and secured a large debt facility from our ethical banking partner, so we’re looking to build a team that can help us take things to the next level.


The role

This role is all about learning through doing, joining an existing team that takes care of day to day Operations. In the first instance, we're looking for generalist Interns who are keen to get to grips with all aspects of the Operational side of the business.


Sometimes that will mean troubleshooting, but after every fire you'll take a step back and think about how to help the team design and implement a process that could have dealt with the issue proactively.


What you will do

We're still very much a scale-up, so your role will be broad. At a minimum it will include:

  • Day to day involvement in vehicle, driver and route management

  • Looking after our customers across multiple channels

  • Helping to manage vehicle and charger maintenance

  • Assisting with the planning of future routes and expansion

You'll be engaging with a committed Operations team to ensure we have 24/7 coverage. Part of this may mean pitching in and helping with weekend or evening cover in case of incidents, whilst also working to ensure we keep these unanticipated events to a minimum.

Please note - this is an on-site role, and interested parties should only apply if they are able to work from our office in central Edinburgh.


Start dates and timings
We're looking to engage the right applicants for an initial period of three months, starting in October 2026


The long term
We're growing very rapidly, and our hope is very much that our internship programme could lead to permanent roles for the right candidates.


Diversity and equality

At Ember, we support diversity across our team and customers. We work to ensure every employee feels respected and able to give their best, whether temporary, part-time or full-time. We’re happy to offer flexible working patterns where they make sense, are compassionate when it comes to time off and offer enhanced maternity and paternity leave.

Read more about our approach in our Equal Opportunities Policy.


What’s on offer

This is a paid graduate internship, and conditions will satisfy the requirements of the National Living Wage.


How do I apply?

Apply using the form, providing a CV and a cover letter explaining why you're right for this opportunity. 


How you work and think is much more important to us than any specific industry experience. A genuine passion for climate or public transport, or even both, are also very valuable at an entry level, and we'll teach you the rest. You don't need to be a master of anything but shouldn't feel out of your depth anywhere.


Whether you're a university leaver or a veteran, a recent graduate looking for first-hand experience in Climate and Technology or a frustrated Public Transport enthusiast who would love to make the switch into this industry, we're keen to meet people with a passion to make a real difference.


We look for a range of qualities in all members of Ember's Operations Team, and the following should resonate with you:

  • A strong sense of what good really looks like whatever the topic, problem, or issue. After all, good is good.

  • An instinct and curiosity that draws you to problems and drives you to find a solution, rather than hoping someone else picks it up.

  • An innate structured thinker – everything is a series of steps which can be broken down and rationalised.

  • An ability to build strong relationships with a diverse range of people, from drivers to software developers.

Ce qu’on vous propose 

Dans le cadre d’une création de poste, notre équipe Support/Run (composée de 10 personnes) recherche son futur manager. Votre mission repose sur 3 enjeux : un management humain de proximité, l’excellence opérationnelle et le pilotage de la rentabilité des contrats.

Et concrètement :

  1.    Management d’équipe :

  •          Animer, fédérer et accompagner au quotidien votre équipe de techniciens et d’administrateurs IT

  •          Assurer le développement de leurs compétences : réaliser les entretiens, identifier les besoins en formation et accompagner les montées en compétences

  •          Gérer l’organisation du service : gérer les plannings, la répartition de la charge de travail, les astreintes et l’intégration des nouveaux arrivants.

  •          Anticiper les besoins en ressources, optimiser leur répartition et garantir une vision claire de l’activité à venir de façon hebdomadaire

  •          Soutenir les équipes faces aux incidents critiques ou aux situations complexes

  •          Suivre les indicateurs (KPI) via des tableaux de bord mêlant performances opérationnelles et financières.

  •          Veiller à l’amélioration continue : optimiser les process et valoriser la base de connaissance/l’automatisation pour améliorer la marge opérationnelle.

 

3.    Pilotage financier

  •          Assurer la productivité : suivre le taux de charge, l’imputabilité et maximiser l’efficience globale de l’équipe.

  •          Suivre la rentabilité financière des contrats de service (forfaits, run, support) et veiller à l’adéquation entre le temps passé et les engagements contractuels.

  •          Optimiser les coûts de production : analyser le coût de revient des prestations, identifier les axes d'amélioration opérationnels et financiers et proposer des plans d'action pour renforcer la performance de l'activité.

  •          Soutenir l’activité d’avant-vente/renouvellements : apporter son regard opérationnel lors du chiffrage de nouveaux contrats ou du renouvellement des contrats existants.

 

Ce poste est fait pour vous si :

Vous avez acquis une expérience de 3 ans dans l’encadrement direct d’équipes techniques au sein d’un intégrateur, un éditeur ou une ESN. Vous mettez en avant un management de proximité exigeant et bienveillant, en développant l’autonomie, l’engagement et la culture du résultat de votre équipe.

title: AI Response Analyst
description:
The work

iMerit, an EXL company, is looking for detail oriented analysts to evaluate and rank AI generated responses to image based prompts. You will judge answers on accuracy, relevance, clarity, conciseness, safety, localization, and how well they follow the user's instructions, then explain your reasoning in writing.

Much of the job comes down to this: look at the image, look at what the model said about it, and decide whether the two actually match.

What you will do

  • Review images alongside the prompts and responses attached to them

  • Interpret both visual and conversational context before scoring anything

  • Compare multiple responses and rank them against defined criteria

  • Confirm that descriptions and claims about an image reflect what is actually there

  • Verify factual claims using approved research sources

  • Flag tasks that cannot be reliably evaluated

  • Write clear justification for every ranking you submit

What you bring

  • A sharp eye for visual detail and the patience to look twice

  • Strong critical thinking, research skills, and reading comprehension

  • Sound judgment and well supported decision making

  • Professional written English, including the ability to describe what you see precisely

  • The consistency to apply detailed guidelines the same way, task after task

  • Experience in image annotation, content review, editing, research, design, or localization is welcome but not essential.

Good to know

  • Independent contractor engagement for the length of the project.Â

  • Fully remote with flexible scheduling around agreed deadlines.

  • Tasks include visual content, so a device and connection that display images comfortably are required.

  • Volume varies with project demand.
